title: 2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix
text:
== Summary ==
(Test document) The 2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix was the final round of the 2021 season at Yas Marina Circuit.

== Race ==
Nicholas Latifi crashed late in the race and the safety car was deployed. Race director Michael Masi allowed only the lapped cars between Hamilton and Verstappen to overtake, and the safety car came in with one lap to go. Verstappen passed Hamilton on the final lap.

== Mercedes' protest ==
Mercedes protested the result; the stewards dismissed the protests.
